correctness.rationale: The source reduction gives an exact finite sign system and unique tail continuation. Its complement set simplifies to {0,...,Q}; the resulting boundary vector has limiting covariance k^{-2}(I+(k+2)J), while every free block has size (k-1)T/k^2+O_k(1). A parity-aware Rademacher local limit theorem, exponential tail control, and a multivariate CLT yield the stated Gaussian integral. The determinant and quadratic-form evaluation gives the closed-form constant. Exact finite counts agree with direct boundary enumeration in small cases and converge numerically to the predicted constants.

originality.rationale: Li--Xu--Yan arXiv:2609.20385v1 proves only order-of-magnitude bounds for fixed c. Full-text inspection and exact/synonymous searches found no prior explicit leading constant, asymptotic ratio, or diffusive c_T/sqrt(T) limit profile. Earlier weighted-representation papers checked address existence, structure, representation-value growth, or small-threshold formulas. The source is extremely recent, so unindexed contemporaneous work remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The theorem upgrades a new order-of-magnitude result to an exact asymptotic, identifies a closed-form universal fixed-offset constant, sharpens cross-weight comparison to an asymptotic ratio, supplies an exact constant for the Yan--Shan g_{k,m} family, and reveals an explicit Gaussian profile on the natural square-root offset scale.
